raw_segments.text: In countries like France, where the peasants constitute far more than half of the population,
it was natural that writers who sided with the proletariat against the bourgeoisie
should use, in their criticism of the bourgeois regime, the standard of the peasant and petty bourgeois,
and from the standpoint of these intermediate classes should take up the cudgels for the working class.
Sismondi was the head of this school, not only in France, but also in England.
